purpose: Teach: 渦/大雪/鮨/呪文/電灯/コンセント/キノコ/ハンバーガー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが海の渦のお話してくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me the most interesting story about sea whirlpools.
lines.style: Gentle, warm. Sharing something she found touching. Slow, unhurried cadence. A slight lift at the end—inviting him to be curious like she is.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、明日大雪だってニュースで言ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, the news said there's going to be heavy snow tomorrow.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation, delivered quietly. Not urgent, just noticing. A small pause before speaking, like he's been thinking about this. Calm and certain.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと鮨屋に行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, would you like to go get sushi with Dad tomorrow?
lines.style: Warm invitation, spoken gently. A slight lift in her voice as if offering him something special. Unhurried. The tone of someone making a small moment for her child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、絵本で「呪文を唱える」シーン読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read a scene in my picture book where someone casts a spell!
lines.style: Bright, direct excitement. Quick attack on the opening word. Eager to share. A small bounce in the rhythm. Not loud—genuine delight, the kind that comes from wanting to tell her something he loves.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家の電灯を全部LEDに換えるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, they're going to change all the lights in the house to LED bulbs.
lines.style: Conversational but thoughtful. Sharing information the way she'd mention something she overheard. Steady pacing. A slight reflective quality—not heavy, just observant.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、コンセントには指入れちゃダメだよね
lines.en: Mom, you're not supposed to put your fingers in electrical outlets, right?
lines.style: Seeking reassurance gently, not anxiously. Quiet and earnest. A slight upward lift at the very end—checking, asking for confirmation. Not afraid, just making sure he understands.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんとキノコ狩りに行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, shall we go mushroom picking with Grandpa?
lines.style: Warm and inviting, like she's imagining the outing already. Soft, unhurried. A gentle lilt at the end—an offer, not a question. The tenderness of a mother suggesting something she knows he'll enjoy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとハンバーガー食べたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to eat hamburgers with Dad!
lines.style: Direct, warm want. Eager but not demanding. Quick, natural pacing. A small warmth in the tone—he's looking forward to it. Genuine child enthusiasm without strain.
